subject: EU/APAC data residency — deployment mode follow-up
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Taylor <lisa.taylor@nordbank.com>, NordBank Procurement <procurement@nordbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:18:00 +0000
Subject: EU/APAC data residency — deployment mode follow-up

Thanks again for your time today — quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Call notes (summary)
- Primary requirement: all customer data (inference payloads, KV cache, customer artifacts) must remain within the EU.
- Secondary need: NordBank has APAC offices that will need read-only access to inference features, but you do not want EU data to be replicated to APAC storage.
- Security asks: customer-managed KMS keys, audit logs, and SOC2 evidence requested.

Deployment modes we discussed
- Hosted API (EU region): fastest onboarding; inference/data plane served from EU region. Control-plane metadata may be in our control plane unless we enable enterprise regionalization.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool in an EU region with data isolation and stronger tenancy guarantees.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer-managed networking and keys; can be fully isolated and meet strict residency/compliance.

Clarifying questions to validate requirements
1) Is the constraint that no customer data can ever leave the EU (including any control-plane telemetry), or is the primary restriction just the inference data plane?
2) For APAC users: do they require write access, or is read/query access sufficient (we can proxy traffic without replicating storage)?

Next steps
- I attached a short region matrix and a draft SOW to show differences (Redwood_Region_Matrix_20270422.pdf; SOW_NordBank_Draft_20270422.docx).
- Proposed: technical deep-dive with our infra lead (Marissa) to go over KMS, control plane regionalization, and network topology. Are you available Tue/Wed next week for a 60-min session?

Thanks — I’ll also include a proposed mutual action plan after we confirm the next call.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Lisa Taylor <lisa.taylor@nordbank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NordBank Procurement <procurement@nordbank.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU/APAC data residency — deployment mode follow-up

Thanks, Aditya — really helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Residency requirement: NordBank’s policy is strict — customer data and any derived artifacts (including caches) must remain within the EU. We cannot have inference payloads or derived caches replicated to non-EU regions. We also have legal constraints on certain telemetry (IP addresses, user identifiers) leaving the jurisdiction.

2) Control plane: we need to understand whether Redwood’s hosted offering stores any PII/identifiers in a global control plane. If it does, we need a guarantee that such metadata can be regionalized to an EU-only control plane or that it can be disabled/obfuscated.

3) KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key). Is that supported for Dedicated or Private? Is it possible for Hosted with enterprise configuration?

4) Timeline: procurement is targeting a production pilot in Q3 2027. We’d like an initial estimate of onboarding effort and any gating items (legal/IT security review).

I’ve attached the compliance questionnaire we use — happy to highlight the relevant sections if you want (attached as a quick reference in my reply).

Regards,
Lisa Taylor
Head of AI Programs | NordBank
lisa.taylor@nordbank.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Taylor <lisa.taylor@nordbank.com>
Cc: NordBank Procurement <procurement@nordbank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 19:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU/APAC data residency — deployment mode follow-up

Hi Lisa — great questions, answers below at a high level. Marissa will join the tech call to cover details.

Residency and control plane
- Hosted API (EU region): inference data plane (request payloads, model I/O, KV cache) is processed and stored in the EU region. By default some non-sensitive control-plane telemetry (usage counters, anonymized metrics) flows to our global control plane; for enterprise customers we can regionalize the control plane to EU or disable telemetry retention beyond what’s required for the service. We can provide a control-plane data flow diagram on the next call.

KMS and encryption
- Private (VPC/on-prem): supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and HSM integrations.
- Dedicated: supports customer-managed KMS for at-rest model artifacts and logs; keys can be managed via your cloud provider in the EU.
- Hosted (self-serve): does not support BYOK today, but we do offer an enterprise-hosted option that enables customer-managed keys and regional control-plane configs.

APAC access
- APAC users can access inference endpoints proxied through an EU-only data plane — we can avoid replicating storage to APAC by enabling edge routing without cross-region replication. Latency for APAC queries will be higher if traffic routes to EU, but we can discuss hybrid architectures (edge cache with EU-only origin) if you need lower latency.

Next steps
- Technical deep-dive with Marissa (30–60 min) to walk through control-plane flows, KMS options, and the SOW assumptions.
- I’ll prepare a short mutual action plan (owners, milestones, procurement gating items) for your procurement team.

Are you available Mon 26 Apr 10:00–11:30 CEST or Tue 27 Apr 09:00–12:00 CEST?

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Taylor <lisa.taylor@nordbank.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU/APAC data residency — deployment mode follow-up

Hi Lisa — looping in a couple technical clarifications ahead of the architecture call. Short answers below and happy to dive deeper on the call.

1) Hosted EU region details
- Data plane: inference requests, model I/O, and KV cache live in the EU region. We do not replicate inference payloads to non-EU regions in the EU-hosted configuration.
- Control plane: for standard hosted accounts we collect basic telemetry in our global control plane; for enterprise accounts we can provision a regionalized control plane (EU-only) to keep metadata within the EU boundary.

2) Dedicated vs Private
- Dedicated (EU cluster): dedicated GPU nodes + tenant isolation; supports customer-managed KMS (via your cloud provider) and configurable audit log retention directed to an EU logging endpoint. Good fit if you need predictable throughput and data isolation without on-prem ops.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full customer-managed networking, optional on-prem deployment, BYOK/HSM, and audit logs under your control. This is the highest-assurance option.

3) Cross-region routing and APAC access
- We can ensure that all persisted artifacts remain EU-only. APAC users can call EU endpoints (higher latency) or we can provision an APAC edge that proxies to EU origin without persisting data in APAC. We do not enable automatic cross-region replication unless explicitly configured.

Suggested next steps for the architecture call
- Walk through control-plane/data-plane diagrams (I will share the slide deck).
- KMS and key-rotation workflow (bring-your-own-key options).
- Network design: VPC peering, egress rules, and audit log sinks (SIEM integration).

Proposed times I can join:
- Mon 26 Apr 10:00–11:30 CEST
- Tue 27 Apr 09:00–11:00 CEST

If one of those works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Infrastructure Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
